resolution.note: rerun restarts a landing without a published exit; flock in the detached wrapper runs one deliver

title: slice landing start survives a crash between journal save and spawn
body:
Outcome: the slice landing start survives a crash between the journal save and the detached spawn. Today `krn slice run` saves `landing` before `runtime.detach`; a hard crash in that window leaves `landing: running` with no process, and main CI plus hygiene never run until the lead runs plain `krn deliver`.
Evidence: PR #210 review 2 record .krn/runs/review-series/3a58521cdc2a7a6596f4795c767717fcb216d88d1ee03d33420a2a917da19d48/records/2.json (src/slice/run.ts:913-914), accepted by lead override.
Proof: an observer crashes the run after the landing save and before spawn, and a rerun starts exactly one landing deliver (e.g. a launch id written by the detached wrapper as its first act, or a uniquely named systemd-run unit checked by identity).
Decisions: keeps D21/D30; no gate removed.
